findings.title: Conditional serializer hook misnamed so it never runs
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb the method is defined as `include_website_name` without a trailing `?`. ActiveModel::Serializers looks for `include_<attr>?`, so this method is never called. As a result `website_name` is always serialized, even when `website` is blank (as nil), and any future filtering for trust/privacy is bypassed.

findings.title: website_name bypasses TL0 untrusted-field hiding
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb `website` is listed in `untrusted_attributes` so anonymous viewers do not see TL0 users' website/bio/location, but newly added `website_name` is only added to `attributes` and not to `untrusted_attributes`. Since `website_name` contains the website host plus path, it leaks the very URL that `website` hiding is meant to suppress for spam prevention.

findings.title: Scheme-less websites return nil and hide profile link
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb `website_name` is derived via `URI(website.to_s).host` which returns nil when the stored website has no scheme such as `example.com/user`. The method then returns nil early, and the profile template in user.hbs gates display on `model.website_name`, so a user with a valid scheme-less `model.website` shows no website link at all.

findings.title: Query, fragment and port stripped from displayed path
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb `website_name` is built as `website_host + URI(website).path` when domains match. That drops the query string, fragment, and non-default port, so `http://example.com/page?x=1#y` displays as `example.com/page` despite the PR goal of showing the complete path. Users cannot distinguish such URLs.

findings.title: Untrusted-attributes test not updated for website_name
findings.body: In spec/serializers/user_serializer_spec.rb the TL0-anonymous test lists bio/location/website/profile backgrounds but omits the new `website_name`. The test therefore cannot catch the privacy regression where `website_name` remains visible while `website` is hidden.
